title: Chapter 109 Did I Give You Face?
content:
Chapter 109 Did I Give You Face?

That figure was naturally Gongsun Mo.

At the original place, Yan Lingyun stared at Gongsun Mo in the distance with cold eyes.

The next moment, as Yan Lingyun's figure trembled, Gongsun Mo in the distance looked ugly.

"Drive!"

Suddenly, a mysterious halo condensed in front of Gongsun Mo.

However, before Gongsun Mo could react, accompanied by a roar, Gongsun Mo retreated thousands of feet away again.

At this moment, Gongsun Mo was a little skeptical about life.

Did she encounter a monster?

Even if the other party was a strong man from the fairyland like her, the other party was now in the true self realm, which was lower than her current cultivation, but the other party almost crushed her.

How could this be possible.

For a long time, fighting across levels was her job.

"Who are you?"

At this time, Gongsun Mo asked this question again.

"You are not qualified to know my identity."

The extremely cold voice sounded from Yan Lingyun's mouth.

This statement was extremely arrogant, but Gongsun Mo was helpless.

She had no way to deal with the other party. Not only was the other party stronger than her, but he was still so fierce even though he knew the power behind her.

Then there was only one possibility, the power behind the woman in front of him must be even more terrifying.

Thinking of this, Gongsun Mo's face became even uglier.

After a moment of silence, Gongsun Mo slowly said: "Is there any misunderstanding between us?"

Showing weakness.

As soon as this statement came out, it meant that Gongsun Mo had completely admitted defeat.

With just two moves, Gongsun Mo had no intention of resisting.

Hearing Gongsun Mo's words, Yan Lingyun sneered.

"You really take your Immortal Spirit Holy Land seriously, and you dare to come to this lower world in person. Am I giving you face?"

The last time the Holy Lord Gongsun Sheng of the Immortal Spirit Holy Land attacked, the Immortal Spirit Holy Land was on her must-kill list, and now, not long after, it came again, and it was in person.

More importantly, the other party's goal is her own man and daughter.

Just for this reason, Yan Lingyun would not be too much to kill the other party's holy land a hundred times.

"Do you really want to do this?"

At this time, Gongsun Mo's temper also came up.

The strange woman in front of her was really too domineering. She actually despised her fairy holy land so much.

In the Wood Fairy Realm, there are indeed many stronger than her fairy holy land, but as far as she knows, there is no one who dares not to take her fairy holy land seriously and ignore it.

After all, which force in the fairy world does not have some trump cards.

A force that is only the strongest at the fairy king level on the surface, if you dare to destroy it, he can give you a quasi-fairy emperor.

Not to mention that she has inherited the fairy holy land for endless years.

At this time, Yan Lingyun shook her head slightly.

"From the moment you stepped into this place, your fate of death has been doomed, including the shitty holy land behind you."

Yan Lingyun said indifferently.

Hearing this, Gongsun Mo sneered.

"Who decided it? Just you?"

"Just me."

Buzz——

Suddenly, a mysterious force flowed from Yan Lingyun's hands.

The next moment, Yan Lingyun suddenly made a move.

Boom!

In an instant, the entire void collapsed completely, and countless cracks continued to spread from it.

The fragments of the void turned into countless meteors, pouring down from the sky, which was very beautiful.

Feeling the horror of this power, Gongsun Mo's face turned pale, "Holy Spirit Pearl, go!"

A crystal clear crystal ball emitting terrifying fluctuations flew out of Gongsun Mo's hand and went straight towards Yan Lingyun.

Boom!

Another explosion sounded.

Gongsun Mo took back the Holy Spirit Pearl and immediately found that it was covered with cracks.

Crack-

The next moment, the entire Holy Spirit Pearl turned into powder in an instant.

"What!"

Gongsun Mo showed an unbelievable expression and then looked into the distance.

Yan Lingyun was unharmed.

At this time, Yan Lingyun's next attack had already arrived.

"Damn it!"

Gongsun Mo never thought that she would encounter such a monster when she came to the lower world to avenge her sister.

After a few breaths, Gongsun Mo fled in a direction with blood all over her body.

She couldn't beat him at all, so she could only escape.

However, Yan Lingyun didn't want to let her go.

In this way, the two chased each other and soon came to a dark star field.

Here, the strong breath of death continued to permeate.

If Lu Daosheng was here, he would definitely recognize that this was the place where he dropped the air.

"Second An, I order you to stop her!"

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly spoke not far behind Gongsun Mo.

The next moment, a strange force suddenly blocked Gongsun Mo.

Seeing this, Gongsun Mo's face was ugly, and he had to act quickly. Although he easily broke the obstacle in front of him, he still paused for a moment.

And in this moment, Yan Lingyun had already blocked Gongsun Mo.

"Run, why don't you run?"

Yan Lingyun sneered at Gongsun Mo, who had an extremely ugly face and a bit of fear in front of him, and walked towards Gongsun Mo step by step.

Gongsun Mo kept retreating, and the fear in his eyes was almost turned into substance.

Taking a deep breath, Gongsun Mo said in a deep voice: "I will remember you."

Then, Gongsun Mo's body suddenly became illusory.

"She is going to run."

At this time, a voice suddenly sounded in the dark.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun snorted coldly.

"It's too late to think about going back to the fairyland now!"

Then Yan Lingyun quickly took action.

Swish!

Suddenly, accompanied by the spray of terrifying fairy power, a muffled hum sounded, and Gongsun Mo had already disappeared on the spot.

Gongsun Mo's short journey to the lower world ended in advance.

Although she did not take revenge, she did not gain nothing.

At least, she was injured and her foundation was damaged.

If there were no heaven-defying treasures, she might never break through again in her life.

On the spot, Yan Lingyun looked at the blood in her hand and frowned.

Mistake.

Her attack did not kill the opponent.

She did not expect that this guy actually had so many treasures. If he was not serious, it would be really difficult to kill him.

If Gongsun Mo knew this, Gongsun Mo would definitely suffer a great loss of Taoism.

Is this not serious yet?

With a great realm, he suppressed her who was regarded as the daughter of heaven.

If he was serious, would he kill her instantly?

At this time, Yan Lingyun was about to leave, and seemed to think of something and looked back.

"Second An, when will you return to the fairyland?"

The next moment, an illusory figure slowly emerged.

"Miss Yan, it may take some time, and the plan has changed. I met a very interesting little guy here."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun raised her eyebrows slightly.

"Want to accept a disciple?"

The phantom shook his head and chuckled: "I don't want to accept a disciple, but just pass on my lifelong learning to the other party. After all, it would be a pity if my skills were lost, and this little guy really suits my appetite."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded.

She was just curious about this matter, and she would not care about the guy in front of her.

Yan Lingyun was about to leave when the shadow suddenly said, "Miss Yan."

"Hmm?"

The shadow said, "Miss Yan, the person you care about is very special."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun paused for a moment and then left the Death Star Region.
